transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in today?

Hi. Well, I suppose what brings me in is that I recently took on this historical society project, and... I just went at it like I could run the whole fundraiser by myself. 

I was starting all these new quilt designs, calling up volunteers, making schedules, and just promising deadlines that I couldn't possibly meet. I guess I just took on way too much at once, and... well, that's why I'm here.
How long did this period of unusually intense activity and taking on too much last?
Well, I'd say that whole overdriven stretch went on for about five months. Yeah, about five months of just going and going like that before everything finally fell apart.
During that five-month period, did you feel unusually elevated or irritable compared with your usual self?

Well, at first, I felt almost... glowing, I guess you could say. It was like every idea I had was just wonderful. But then, if anyone questioned me or tried to slow me down, I got really snappish. I just acted like they were standing in the way of what I needed to do.
During that five-month period, did you need less sleep than usual and still feel rested?

Yes, I did. For a while there, I was sleeping only a few hours a night, and I'd wake up completely ready to sew or start making phone calls. I didn't feel tired at all. But now... well, now it's very different. These days I either just lie awake worrying, or I sleep late and still feel completely worn out when I finally get up.
Did this period of unusually high energy and activity cause serious problems in your work, relationships, or finances?

Yes, it did. Um, my husband has had to step in and take over all our normal household routines. And he's had to deal with the historical society for me, too, because... well, I just stopped keeping my commitments there. I had promised them so much during that time, and eventually I just couldn't even face the people who were waiting on me. So he's had to handle all of that.
During that period, did you hear or see things that others could not, or believe things that others said were clearly untrue?

No, nothing like that. I didn't see or hear anything that wasn't there, and I don't think I had any strange beliefs. I just had a lot of big ideas about what I could accomplish, but they were real things, just... maybe too much for one person to do.
